headline: Chikkaballapur tackles child malnutrition with SaiSure supplement for SAM and MAM children across all six taluks
summary: Chikkaballapur district has 1593 anganwadi kendras, most without their own buildings and some in dilapidated structures or temples. Since 2022, targeted nutritional interventions distribute SaiSure supplement to severely and moderately malnourished (SAM/MAM) children across all six taluks. Around 1175 MAM children in Sidlaghatta and Gudibande taluks received immunity-boosting kits from February to July 2022, with parents reporting significant improvement within three months. A recent October 2025 launch targets SAM and MAM children with four 500g pouches over six months. The district also addressed fluoride-contaminated groundwater through 10 defluoridation plants, reducing medical costs by 100 percent in some villages.

modelFactorWhy.why: The pages discuss anganwadi infrastructure problems and nutrition programmes but provide no data on school enrollment rates for 3-6 year-olds in Chikkaballapur district.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: Early childhood education centres like anganwadis support child development, nutrition monitoring, and school readiness, reducing stunting risk.

modelFactorWhy.factor: Mothers who took iron-folic acid for 180+ days in pregnancy
modelFactorWhy.why: No pages mention maternal iron-folic acid supplementation during pregnancy or antenatal care practices in Chikkaballapur district.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: Adequate iron-folic acid intake during pregnancy prevents maternal anaemia and supports fetal growth, reducing low birth weight and stunting.

modelFactorWhy.factor: Household members covered by health insurance
modelFactorWhy.why: One page notes reduced medical costs by 100 percent after water quality intervention, suggesting healthcare access barriers existed. No direct health insurance coverage data provided.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: Health insurance improves access to preventive and curative services, enabling timely treatment of childhood illnesses that contribute to stunting.
